title: L&T Finance's Pitch Point Launchpad for AI Start-ups: Past winners Arrowhead AI and SpoofSense Share Success Stories Ahead of the Second Edition
hook_text: Arrowhead AI won Pitch Point Launchpad.
script:
Arrowhead AI won the first edition of the Pitch Point Launchpad.
L and T Finance designed this platform to fund early stage technology startups across the country.
SpoofSense also joined past winners to share success stories ahead of the second edition.
The initiative gives founders funding opportunities and mentorship to scale their products.
Applications for the upcoming second cohort are now open for builders nationwide.
Would your company apply for this?
